capabilities: capture and edit tasks through a form that writes note-per-task records
build RFC 5545 RRULE recurrence rules with a visual builder and English preview
compute next due dates and reschedule overdue tasks in bulk with a preview
display tasks in a sidebar pane partitioned into Overdue, Today, This week, Needs attention, Later
link tasks to asset notes via a type-ahead property and create asset notes in place
disambiguation: Not a Bases plugin or a checkbox tracker like Tasks; each task is its own note carrying a type: task property, and the base file is optional.
extras: Makes no network requests, collects no telemetry, and never deletes notes; it finds tasks by reading frontmatter across the whole vault, narrowable via an Excluded folders setting. Includes mobile-specific UI for the notes field and warns that new vaults need four settings configured.
intentEvidence: TaskNotes is also note-per-task, built around a calendar, pomodoro and time tracking. If you want time tracking, use that.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in recurring-task system, and existing task plugins track inline checkboxes or add time tracking instead of storing standard RRULE rules on notes.

relations.evidence: Tasks manages checkboxes written inline in note bodies. Different unit of work entirely
TaskNotes is also note-per-task, built around a calendar, pomodoro and time tracking
main.js is a bundle: it contains rrule (BSD-3-Clause)

summary: Note-per-task manager that stores RFC 5545 RRULE recurrence in frontmatter, with a capture form, sidebar pane, and optional Bases table view.
